Topics · One God, one message

If we are one family, why are we so different?

Different tongues and colours are a sign; division in religion is a human act. Where would you draw that line?

Part 1 of 3

﴿وَمِنْ ءَايَـٰتِهِۦ خَلْقُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَٱخْتِلَـٰفُ أَلْسِنَتِكُمْ وَأَلْوَٰنِكُمْ ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍ لِّلْعَـٰلِمِينَ﴾

Translation of the meaning

And of His signs is the creation of the heavens and the earth and the diversity of your languages and your colors. Indeed in that are signs for those of knowledge.

Quran · Ar-Rum 30:22

Translation

Didn’t he who made me in the womb make him? Didn’t one fashion us in the womb?

Original · Hebrew

הֲֽ֝לֹא־בַ֭בֶּטֶן עֹשֵׂ֣נִי עָשָׂ֑הוּ וַ֝יְכֻנֶ֗נּוּ בָּרֶ֥חֶם אֶחָֽד׃

Job · 31:15

World English Bible

If difference were a defect, you would have to wish for a world of one language and one colour. This verse sets the variety of tongues and colours in one sentence with the making of the heavens and earth, and calls it a sign, a mark that points to its maker. What the Maker made cannot be a fault in itself. So the question shifts. Not why we differ, but what the difference points to.

A question for you

Which of these differences seems to you the finest thing about people?

If you sayLanguages
ThenEach language is a way of seeing the world, and the verse names it first.
If you sayFaces and colours
ThenSo you take colour as beauty, which is close to what the verse calls a sign.
If you sayDifference tires me more than it pleases me
ThenThat is honest, and many feel it. The next part asks what it is for, then.

Part 2 of 3

﴿وَأَنزَلْنَآ إِلَيْكَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ بِٱلْحَقِّ مُصَدِّقًا لِّمَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ مِنَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ وَمُهَيْمِنًا عَلَيْهِ ۖ فَٱحْكُم بَيْنَهُم بِمَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ ۖ وَلَا تَتَّبِعْ أَهْوَآءَهُمْ عَمَّا جَآءَكَ مِنَ ٱلْحَقِّ ۚ لِكُلٍّ جَعَلْنَا مِنكُمْ شِرْعَةً وَمِنْهَاجًا ۚ وَلَوْ شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ لَجَعَلَكُمْ أُمَّةً وَٰحِدَةً وَلَـٰكِن لِّيَبْلُوَكُمْ فِى مَآ ءَاتَىٰكُمْ ۖ فَٱسْتَبِقُوا۟ ٱلْخَيْرَٰتِ ۚ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ مَرْجِعُكُمْ جَمِيعًا فَيُنَبِّئُكُم بِمَا كُنتُمْ فِيهِ تَخْتَلِفُونَ﴾

Translation of the meaning

And We have revealed to you, [O Muḥammad], the Book [i.e., the Qur’ān] in truth, confirming that which preceded it of the Scripture and as a criterion over it. So judge between them by what Allāh has revealed and do not follow their inclinations away from what has come to you of the truth. To each of you We prescribed a law and a method.[268] Had Allāh willed, He would have made you one nation [united in religion], but [He intended] to test you in what He has given you; so race to [all that is] good.[269] To Allāh is your return all together, and He will [then] inform you concerning that over which you used to differ.

Translator's notes

[268] Prior to this revelation, which supersedes all previous scriptures. [269] i.e., obedience to Allāh according to what He enjoined in the Qur’ān and through the sunnah of His Prophet (ﷺ).

Quran · Al-Ma'idah 5:48

Translation

The fear of Yahweh is clean, enduring forever. Yahweh’s ordinances are true, and righteous altogether. They are more to be desired than gold, yes, than much fine gold, sweeter also than honey and the extract of the honeycomb. Moreover your servant is warned by them. In keeping them there is great reward.

Original · Hebrew

יִרְאַ֤ת יְהוָ֨ה ׀ טְהוֹרָה֮ עוֹמֶ֪דֶת לָ֫עַ֥ד מִֽשְׁפְּטֵי־יְהוָ֥ה אֱמֶ֑ת צָֽדְק֥וּ יַחְדָּֽו׃ הַֽנֶּחֱמָדִ֗ים מִ֭זָּהָב וּמִפַּ֣ז רָ֑ב וּמְתוּקִ֥ים מִ֝דְּבַ֗שׁ וְנֹ֣פֶת צוּפִֽים׃ גַּֽם־עַ֭בְדְּךָ נִזְהָ֣ר בָּהֶ֑ם בְּ֝שָׁמְרָ֗ם עֵ֣קֶב רָֽב׃

the Psalms · 19:9-11

World English Bible

Human difference runs wider than colour and tongue. This verse goes to the harder case: to each a law and a way, and had God willed, He would have made you one nation. So the variety is intended, not accidental. Then it names the purpose: a test in what you were given, and a race toward good deeds. The energy that could become a feud is turned into a contest of kindness, and the ending belongs to God.

A question for you

What, to you, is the difference between a race in doing good and a feud?

If you sayIn a race for good, everyone gains
ThenIn a feud, someone must lose. That is a difference you can test on any religious dispute you see.
If you sayIn a feud, I want the other to lose
ThenThat is the very heart of it. Soon you will see the name the Quran gives that wish.

Part 3 of 3

﴿شَرَعَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلدِّينِ مَا وَصَّىٰ بِهِۦ نُوحًا وَٱلَّذِىٓ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْكَ وَمَا وَصَّيْنَا بِهِۦٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَمُوسَىٰ وَعِيسَىٰٓ ۖ أَنْ أَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلدِّينَ وَلَا تَتَفَرَّقُوا۟ فِيهِ ۚ كَبُرَ عَلَى ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ مَا تَدْعُوهُمْ إِلَيْهِ ۚ ٱللَّهُ يَجْتَبِىٓ إِلَيْهِ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَهْدِىٓ إِلَيْهِ مَن يُنِيبُ١٣ وَمَا تَفَرَّقُوٓا۟ إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَآءَهُمُ ٱلْعِلْمُ بَغْيًۢا بَيْنَهُمْ ۚ وَلَوْلَا كَلِمَةٌ سَبَقَتْ مِن رَّبِّكَ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى لَّقُضِىَ بَيْنَهُمْ ۚ وَإِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ أُورِثُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ لَفِى شَكٍّ مِّنْهُ مُرِيبٍ١٤﴾

Translation of the meaning

He has ordained for you of religion what He enjoined upon Noah and that which We have revealed to you, [O Muḥammad], and what We enjoined upon Abraham and Moses and Jesus - to establish the religion and not be divided therein. Difficult for those who associate others with Allāh is that to which you invite them. Allāh chooses for Himself whom He wills and guides to Himself whoever turns back [to Him]. And they did not become divided until after knowledge had come to them - out of jealous animosity between themselves. And if not for a word[1413] that preceded from your Lord [postponing the penalty] until a specified time, it would have been concluded between them. And indeed, those who were granted inheritance of the Scripture after them are, concerning it, in disquieting doubt.

Translator's notes

[1413] Decree. See footnote to 10:19.

Quran · Ash-Shura 42:13-14

Translation

for you are still fleshly. For insofar as there is jealousy, strife, and factions among you, aren’t you fleshly, and don’t you walk in the ways of men?

Original · Ancient Greek

ἔτι γὰρ σαρκικοί ἐστε. ὅπου γὰρ ἐν ὑμῖν ζῆλος καὶ ἔρις, οὐχὶ σαρκικοί ἐστε καὶ κατὰ ἄνθρωπον περιπατεῖτε;

1 Corinthians · 3:3

World English Bible

Now the line appears on which the whole story rests. Tongues, colours and laws differ because God made them so. Division in the religion is what He forbade: establish the religion and do not split over it. What God commands cannot be what He forbids. So there are two things here, not one: a difference that is God's work, and a division that is people's. The second verse says when the split came and why, and the next questions return to that.

A question for you

Sort these: your language, your customs, your group's law, its quarrel with others. Which are difference, and which division?

If you sayOnly the quarrel is division
ThenThat matches the line drawn here. A harder question follows: how does a quarrel begin?
If you sayThe laws themselves divide us
ThenA real objection. A question of its own takes it up: if the laws differ, is it the same religion?
If you sayI cannot separate them
ThenIn real life they are tangled. That is what makes the line hard to draw, and worth drawing.

The same in the other books

Translation

Pride only breeds quarrels, but wisdom is with people who take advice.

רַק־בְּ֭זָדוֹן יִתֵּ֣ן מַצָּ֑ה וְאֶת־נ֖וֹעָצִ֣ים חָכְמָֽה׃

Proverbs · 13:10

idolatry, sorcery, hatred, strife, jealousies, outbursts of anger, rivalries, divisions, heresies, envy, murders, drunkenness, orgies, and things like these; of which I forewarn you, even as I also forewarned you, that those who practice such things will not inherit God’s Kingdom.

εἰδωλολατρία, φαρμακεία, ἔχθραι, ἔρις, ζῆλος, θυμοί, ἐριθεῖαι, διχοστασίαι, αἱρέσεις, φθόνοι, μέθαι, κῶμοι, καὶ τὰ ὅμοια τούτοις, ἃ προλέγω ὑμῖν καθὼς προεῖπον ὅτι οἱ τὰ τοιαῦτα πράσσοντες βασιλείαν θεοῦ οὐ κληρονομήσουσιν.

Galatians · 5:20-21

World English Bible

Your reflection

Which difference between you and someone close to you has become a division, and what is the smallest step that would make it only a difference again?
